integrity.proof_basis: Invariant-clique classification, signed Lefschetz trace, finite-group character theory, and the cited Latin-square homology theorem.
integrity.reproducibility: check_translation.py enumerates finite test instances and boundary ranks; finite cases do not replace the proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite abelian groups of odd order at least five; complete rational translation-group action on second homology, not an integral lattice classification or equivariant homotopy equivalence. Uses a published nonequivariant all-field homology theorem. Equivalent unindexed prior coverage remains possible.
title: Translation characters of odd-order Latin-square clique homology
